documents.title: Agent Instructions
documents.lead: Concise mandatory rules and the task-based reading map for agents.
documents.policy: Update when mandatory operating rules or reading requirements change.

documents.title: Agent 工作规则
documents.lead: Agent 必须遵守的简明规则与按任务读取地图。
documents.policy: 强制工作规则或读取要求变化后更新。

documents.title: Start Here
documents.lead: Purpose, evidence priority, reading order, and maintenance triggers.
documents.policy: Update when the entry point, reading map, or maintenance protocol changes.

documents.title: 从这里开始
documents.lead: 用途、证据优先级、读取顺序与维护触发条件。
documents.policy: 入口、读取地图或维护协议变化后更新。

documents.title: Project Goal
documents.lead: Durable objective, current milestone, success criteria, and non-goals.
documents.policy: Update only after the user changes the durable project objective.

documents.title: Strategy Contract V4.4
documents.lead: Instrument-neutral entry, exit, state-machine, and timing semantics.
documents.policy: Update when accepted strategy semantics change.

documents.title: V4.4 策略协议
documents.lead: 与品种无关的开仓、平仓、状态机和时序语义。
documents.policy: 已接受的策略语义变化后更新。

documents.title: Instrument Profile Contract
documents.lead: Data, cost, gap, low-activity, scenario, and ranking-lineage bindings.
documents.policy: Update when the instrument-profile interface changes.

documents.title: 品种配置协议
documents.lead: 数据、成本、gap、低活跃、情景和排名谱系绑定。
documents.policy: 品种配置接口变化后更新。

documents.title: Campaign Workflow
documents.lead: Official transfer, local-refinement, and fresh-search modes plus prompt forms.
documents.policy: Update when campaign modes, ranking lineages, or handoff rules change.

documents.title: 实验活动流程
documents.lead: 正式迁移、局部细化、全新搜索模式与简短指令格式。
documents.policy: 实验模式、排名谱系或交接规则变化后更新。

documents.title: 项目目标
documents.lead: 长期目标、当前里程碑、成功标准与非目标。
documents.policy: 只有用户改变长期项目目标时更新。

documents.title: Project Constraints
documents.lead: Confirmed cross-project boundaries, quality rules, and open assumptions.
documents.policy: Update when the user accepts, changes, or retires a durable constraint.

documents.title: 项目约束
documents.lead: 已确认的通用边界、质量规则与待确认假设。
documents.policy: 用户确认、修改或退役长期约束时更新。

documents.title: Current Valid Files
documents.lead: Authoritative entry points, configurations, artifacts, and validity boundaries.
documents.policy: Update when an authoritative path, branch, configuration, or artifact changes.

documents.title: 当前有效文件
documents.lead: 权威入口、配置、产物与有效性边界。
documents.policy: 权威路径、分支、配置或产物变化后更新。

documents.title: Current Version Notes
documents.lead: Current deliverables, behavior, structure, interfaces, dependencies, and known gaps.
documents.policy: Update after a deliverable, behavior, structure, interface, dependency, or procedure change.

documents.title: 当前版本说明
documents.lead: 当前交付物、行为、结构、接口、依赖与已知缺口。
documents.policy: 交付物、行为、结构、接口、依赖或流程变化后更新。

documents.title: Code Architecture
documents.lead: Current code flow, components, responsibilities, dependencies, and boundaries.
documents.policy: Update when code entry points, component responsibilities, call relationships, data flow, dependencies, or interface boundaries change.

documents.title: 代码架构
documents.lead: 当前代码流程、组件、职责、依赖与边界。
documents.policy: 代码入口、组件职责、调用关系、数据流、依赖或接口边界变化后更新。

documents.title: Current Tasks
documents.lead: Active work, ownership, status, acceptance, blockers, and handoff state.
documents.policy: Update when a task is declared, completed, blocked, resumed, or changes scope.

documents.title: 当前任务清单
documents.lead: 当前工作、负责人、状态、验收、阻塞与交接信息。
documents.policy: 任务被声明、完成、阻塞、恢复或改变范围时更新。

documents.title: Work Progress
documents.lead: Completed or materially changed work, evidence, outcomes, limits, and handoff paths.
documents.policy: Append after completed or materially changed work; archive obsolete detailed bodies when the active method or major version changes.

documents.title: 工作进展
documents.lead: 已完成或发生重要变化的工作、证据、结果、限制与交接路径。
documents.policy: 工作完成或发生重要变化后追加；当前方法或主版本变化时存档已经失效的详细正文。

documents.title: Experiment Progress
documents.lead: Round-by-round experimental motives, scope, outcomes, evidence, and terminal decisions.
documents.policy: Update when an authorized experimental round closes or the experimental evidence boundary changes.

documents.title: 实验进展
documents.lead: 逐轮记录实验动机、范围、结果、证据与终局决定。
documents.policy: 已授权实验轮次闭合或实验有效边界变化后更新。

documents.title: Backtest Management
documents.lead: Mandatory instrument, data-file, and evaluated-interval record for every backtest run.
documents.policy: Read and append before every backtest starts; keep the row if the run stops early.

documents.title: 回测管理
documents.lead: 每次回测必须记录品种、数据文件与实际回测区间。
documents.policy: 每次启动回测前阅读并追加；回测中途停止时仍保留该行。

documents.title: Decisions
documents.lead: Accepted, retired, and reversed durable choices with rationale.
documents.policy: Update when a durable choice is accepted, retired, or reversed.

documents.title: 历史决策
documents.lead: 已确认、已退役与已反转的长期选择及理由。
documents.policy: 长期选择被确认、退役或反转时更新。

documents.title: Change Reasons
documents.lead: Focused rationale for behavior-changing repairs and other changes whose previous behavior and evidence impact must remain auditable.
documents.policy: Add an entry when a material behavior change needs a durable reason, prior behavior, updated behavior, and evidence-impact record.

documents.title: 变更理由
documents.lead: 记录行为修复及其他重要变化的理由、原有表现、新表现与证据影响。
documents.policy: 重要行为变化需要长期保留理由、原有表现、新表现与证据影响时新增记录。

documents.title: Project History
documents.lead: Events that changed the interpretation or direction of the project.
documents.policy: Update when an event changes how past or current work should be understood.

documents.title: 项目历史
documents.lead: 改变项目理解或方向的重要事件。
documents.policy: 事件改变历史或当前工作的解释时更新。

documents.title: Future Research Directions
documents.lead: Testable research questions, strategy hypotheses, and validation paths that are not yet active commitments.
documents.policy: Update when a research question, hypothesis, or validation path appears, changes, becomes active, or is retired; do not place execution rules here.

documents.title: 后续研究方向
documents.lead: 尚未成为当前承诺的可检验研究问题、策略假设与验证路径。
documents.policy: 研究问题、策略假设或验证路径出现、变化、转为当前工作或退役时更新；执行规则不放在这里。

documents.title: Reference Materials
documents.lead: Retained source material, provenance, relevance, and review status.
documents.policy: Update when a retained source or its provenance, relevance, or status changes.

documents.title: 参考材料
documents.lead: 保留材料的来源、用途、相关性与审阅状态。
documents.policy: 保留材料或其来源、相关性、状态变化时更新。

documents.title: Archive Guide
documents.lead: Retention, inactive-state labels, traceability, and restoration rules.
documents.policy: Update when archive structure, retention, or restoration guidance changes.

documents.title: 存档说明
documents.lead: 保留、非活动状态、追溯与恢复规则。
documents.policy: 存档结构、保留或恢复规则变化时更新。

documents.title: Data Requirements
documents.lead: Data sources, contracts, quality, lineage, access, retention, and recovery rules.
documents.policy: Update when a durable source, schema, quality, lineage, access, retention, or recovery rule changes.

documents.title: 数据要求
documents.lead: 数据来源、契约、质量、血缘、访问、保留与恢复规则。
documents.policy: 长期来源、结构、质量、血缘、访问、保留或恢复规则变化后更新。

documents.title: Research Constraints
documents.lead: Research questions, methods, evidence boundaries, reproducibility, and interpretation rules.
documents.policy: Update when an accepted method, evidence boundary, reproducibility rule, or interpretation constraint changes.

documents.title: 研究约束
documents.lead: 研究问题、方法、证据边界、可复现与解释规则。
documents.policy: 已确认方法、证据边界、可复现规则或解释约束变化后更新。

documents.title: Parameter Exploration Guide
documents.lead: Mandatory trade diagnosis, experiment-block design, multi-metric judgment, and next-round CSV handoff rules.
documents.policy: Read for every parameter exploration; update when an accepted diagnosis, improvement, experiment-block, or CSV-handoff rule changes.

documents.title: 参数探索指南
documents.lead: 每次参数探索必须遵守的交易诊断、实验块、多指标判断与下一轮 CSV 交付规则。
documents.policy: 每次参数探索都要阅读；已确认诊断、改善、实验块或 CSV 交付规则变化后更新。
